name: manual_5172a6
claim: In a stacked-PR workflow a base change makes the host rebase the dependent branch: SHAs change but patches do not. Before calling a history change a force-push, check the committer, the patch-id of the top commits and the PR base. Pin review evidence to the head SHA read from the remote at review time, and a receiver of a handed-over SHA must verify that it resolves to the branch head.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-20: Oramasys PR 68 head changed from the reported commit to a different SHA; the committer was GitHub and the top commit patch-id was identical, because the host rebased the stacked PR when its base moved.

rationale: 2026-10-20: Oramasys PR 68 head changed from the reported commit to a different SHA; the committer was GitHub and the top commit patch-id was identical, because the host rebased the stacked PR when its base moved.
